/**
 * Declarations nested in a class, an object, an interface and an enum:
 * functional interfaces, enums, sealed interfaces, interface properties
 * and companion objects.
 */
/** Callbacks a caller registers. */
object Callbacks {
    fun register(done: Done)
    /** Called when the work is done. */
    interface Done {
        fun onDone(ok: Boolean)
    }
}
class Screen {
    /** Maps one value to another. */
    interface Mapper {
        fun map(x: Int): Int
    }
    /** The colour scheme. */
    enum class Mode {
        LIGHT
        DARK
        fun next(): Mode
    }
    /** What the screen shows. */
    interface State {
        /** A label for the state. */
        var label: String
        /** Nothing to show yet. */
        data object Idle {
        }
        /** Work in progress. */
        data class Busy(val label: String, val progress: Int) {
        }
    }
    fun render(mode: Mode, state: State, mapper: Mapper)
}
/** A store of strings. */
interface Repository {
    /** The number of entries. */
    var size: Int
    var name: String
    fun get(id: Int): String
    /** Keeps the entries in memory. */
    class InMemory {
        val size: Int
        var name: String
        fun constructor(size: Int, name: String)
        override fun get(id: Int): String
    }
}
enum class Level {
    LOW(1)
    HIGH(2)
    fun heavier(): Boolean
    object Companion {
        fun parse(s: String): Level
    }
}
</file>
